`api` gives scripts access to our script API. Use it to call into game systems and manage the current script's lifecycle.

## Helpers

### `api.signal` <a class="source-reference__heading-link" style="float: right; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-block: -0.125rem; margin-inline-start: 0.5rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); text-decoration: none;" href="https://github.com/toommyliu/vexed/blob/dev/app/src/renderer/windows/game/scripting/ScriptApi.ts#L178" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true" title="Open source: app/src/renderer/windows/game/scripting/ScriptApi.ts:178" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer"><svg class="source-reference__icon" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m18 16 4-4-4-4"></path><path d="m6 8-4 4 4 4"></path><path d="m14.5 4-5 16"></path></svg></a>

Current script cancellation signal; aborted when the script stops.

```ts
api.signal: AbortSignal
```

**Returns:** `AbortSignal`
